scope: Read-only inventory of the authoritative clear-sky RFMIP SW tolerance failures and the completed v5 solar-only counterfactual. No build, solver, model, download, or threshold change was performed for this inventory.

authoritative_comparison.revision_note: The checked-in comparison artifact records ca33525 as its test-tree commit; the current PR83 worktree is later at dd1b2d. These are recorded separately, not presented as the same checkout.

same_revision_upstream_vs_vendored.result: All four NetCDF output arrays are bitwise equal between the pinned upstream executable and WRF vendored CPU backend; both share the same comparison-to-published SW failures above.
same_revision_upstream_vs_vendored.compiler: GNU Fortran 13.3.0, -O0 -ffree-line-length-none, serial, no RTE_USE_SP; wp is 64-bit double, NetCDF flux variables are float32
same_revision_upstream_vs_vendored.resolution_scope: RFMIP uses 256 LW and 224 SW g-points (g256/g224), unlike WRF g128/g112. This is a same-revision code-port check, not direct WRF-resolution validation.

v4_selector.shape_basis: 18 experiments x 100 sites x 61 levels; zero-based CSV coordinates

v5_execution.runtime: GNU Fortran 13.3.0; -O0 -ffree-line-length-none; same pinned NetCDF runtime closure as baseline; two standalone SW calls.

old_solar_counterfactual_coefficients.qualification: Targeted counterfactual; not authenticated as the coefficient file used to generate the 181204 published reference.

already_performed_diagnostics.same_revision_control: Upstream and vendored CPU give bitwise-equal rld/rlu/rsd/rsu arrays on the official g256/g224 driver/data path.

solar_only_intervention.only_changed_input: The v5 run changes the SW coefficient file between arms; the RFMIP input, executable, and driver are held fixed.
solar_only_intervention.gas_optics: Captured arrays are bitwise equal for all 135 selected profiles, 40,320 stored values per profile.

already_performed_diagnostics.source_normalization: Both arms satisfy the broadband TSI normalization contract; maximum post-normalization sum error is 4.55e-13 (current) and 2.27e-13 (counterfactual).
already_performed_diagnostics.float32_storage: The full-profile write-cast checks exactly reproduce stored NetCDF values, but are not a sufficient cause: for the counterfactual, all 155 prewrite values lie outside the published target's float32 rounding interval and 99 already exceed 1e-5 before storage.
already_performed_diagnostics.counterfactual_errors: All 155 counterfactual stored selected values are one float32 ULP from the published value, yet they still exceed atol=1e-5; current arm has 154/155 selected stored values above 1e-5. This does not establish the old-solar file as historical truth.
already_performed_diagnostics.published_reference_provenance: The published filename labels RTE-RRTMGP-181204 but the exact generating source and solar coefficient-generation SHA are not authenticated by this evidence.

remaining_discriminating_unknowns.unknown: Exact code and coefficient-generation provenance for the published RTE-RRTMGP-181204 rsd/rsu files.
remaining_discriminating_unknowns.why_it_matters: Current pinned upstream (41c5fcd) and vendored backend agree exactly with each other but not with the published SW arrays; source-versus-reference vintage remains unresolved.
remaining_discriminating_unknowns.next_evidence: Find an authoritative archived source/coefficient manifest or reproducible generation recipe for those exact published arrays. Then compare its solar source file and run the unchanged strict test; do not widen tolerance.

remaining_discriminating_unknowns.unknown: Whether the v5 old-solar counterfactual is the exact solar coefficient/input revision used for the 181204 publication.
remaining_discriminating_unknowns.why_it_matters: The intervention demonstrates sensitivity to the SW coefficient file while preserving captured gas optics, but the counterfactual is explicitly unauthenticated.
remaining_discriminating_unknowns.next_evidence: Authenticate the coefficient's origin and generator settings, or treat it only as a sensitivity case.

remaining_discriminating_unknowns.unknown: Why source/flux changes under the solar-only counterfactual do not reproduce the published array within tolerance, despite one-ULP stored residuals in all 155 cells.
remaining_discriminating_unknowns.why_it_matters: Counterfactual source values differ, all 155 prewrite values are outside the target rounding intervals, and float32 casting alone cannot account for the discrepancy.
remaining_discriminating_unknowns.next_evidence: With an authenticated reference-generation path, compare source arrays, spectral source normalization/order and prewrite fluxes at the 155 fixed cells. Keep the current strict threshold.

explicit_nonclaims: No RRTMGP port defect is identified by this inventory.
No published-reference accuracy pass is claimed; the strict SW comparison remains failed.
The v5 counterfactual is not labeled historical or authoritative.
No WRF g128/g112 or all-sky conclusion follows from the g256/g224 RFMIP test.
